sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 fa3 sui1 ran2 jian3 dan1, que4 fei1 chang2 you3 xiao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 방식은 비록 단순하지만 매우 효과적이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Although his method is simple, it is very effective.

meaningEn: to be a guest; to visit as a guest

sentences.hanzi: 周末我去朋友家做客，顺便尝了他妈妈做的菜。
sentences.pinyin: zhou1 mo4 wo3 qu4 peng2 you3 jia1 zuo4 ke4, shun4 bian4 chang2 le5 ta1 ma1 ma5 zuo4 de5 cai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 주말에 나는 친구 집에 손님으로 갔고, 덤으로 그의 어머니가 만든 음식도 맛보았다.
sentences.meaningEn: I visited my friend's home as a guest on the weekend and also got to try the dishes his mother made.

meaningEn: crop; cultivated plant

sentences.hanzi: 今年雨水充足，田里的作物长得特别好。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 yu3 shui3 chong1 zu2, tian2 li3 de5 zuo4 wu4 zhang3 de5 te4 bie2 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 올해는 비가 충분히 내려서 밭의 작물들이 아주 잘 자랐다.
sentences.meaningEn: There was plenty of rain this year, so the crops in the fields grew especially well.

meaningEn: homework; assignment; operation; task

sentences.hanzi: 老师布置的作业不多，但每一道题都很有思考价值。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 bu4 zhi4 de5 zuo4 ye4 bu4 duo1, dan4 mei3 yi2 dao4 ti2 dou1 hen3 you3 si1 kao3 jia4 zhi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님이 내 준 숙제는 많지 않았지만, 모든 문제에 생각해 볼 가치가 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The homework assigned by the teacher was not much, but every question was worth thinking about.

meaningEn: to fight; to conduct operations; combat

sentences.hanzi: 在复杂环境中作战，需要冷静的判断和紧密的配合。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 fu4 za2 huan2 jing4 zhong1 zuo4 zhan4, xu1 yao4 leng3 jing4 de5 pan4 duan4 he2 jin3 mi4 de5 pei4 he2.
sentences.meaningKo: 복잡한 환경에서 작전하려면 침착한 판단과 긴밀한 협조가 필요하다.
sentences.meaningEn: Conducting operations in a complex environment requires calm judgment and close coordination.

meaningEn: to act in a play; to put on an act; to feign

sentences.hanzi: 大家一看就知道他是在做戏，根本没有真心道歉。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 yi2 kan4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shi4 zai4 zuo4 xi4, gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 zhen1 xin1 dao4 qian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 보자마자 그가 연기하고 있다는 걸 알았고, 전혀 진심으로 사과한 것이 아니었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone could tell at a glance that he was just putting on an act and had not apologized sincerely at all.

meaningEn: to engage in scholarly research; to pursue academic studies

sentences.hanzi: 做学问最重要的是保持严谨和诚实的态度。
sentences.pinyin: zuo4 xue2 wen4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4 bao3 chi2 yan2 jin3 he2 cheng2 shi2 de5 tai4 du4.
sentences.meaningKo: 학문을 하는 데 가장 중요한 것은 엄밀하고 정직한 태도를 유지하는 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The most important thing in doing scholarship is to maintain a rigorous and honest attitude.

meaningEn: to be in a dilemma; to be caught between two sides

sentences.hanzi: 两边都希望他支持自己，这让他感到十分左右为难。
sentences.pinyin: liang3 bian1 dou1 xi1 wang4 ta1 zhi1 chi2 zi4 ji3, zhe4 rang4 ta1 gan3 dao4 shi2 fen1 zuo3 you4 wei2 nan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 양쪽 모두 그가 자신을 지지해 주길 바라니 그는 매우 진퇴양난을 느꼈다.
sentences.meaningEn: Both sides hoped he would support them, which left him feeling very much in a dilemma.

meaningEn: restless; unable to sit or stand at ease; uneasy

sentences.hanzi: 在等待检查结果的时候，他一直坐立不安。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 deng3 dai4 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 de5 shi2 hou4, ta1 yi4 zhi2 zuo4 li4 bu4 an1.
sentences.meaningKo: 검사 결과를 기다리는 동안 그는 계속 안절부절못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: While waiting for the test results, he remained restless the whole time.

meaningEn: to decide; to take charge of a decision

sentences.hanzi: 这件事情关系重大，我不敢一个人作主。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 qing2 guan1 xi4 zhong4 da4, wo3 bu4 gan3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zhu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 일은 중대한 관련이 있어서 나는 혼자 결정할 엄두가 나지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: This matter is of great importance, so I do not dare make the decision on my own.

meaningEn: to tease; to make fun of; to toy with

sentences.hanzi: 大家只是开个玩笑，并不是故意作弄他。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi3 shi4 kai1 ge5 wan2 xiao4, bing4 bu2 shi4 gu4 yi4 zuo4 nong4 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 그저 농담을 했을 뿐 일부러 그를 놀리려던 것은 아니었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone was just joking and did not deliberately mean to tease him.

meaningEn: acting force; applied force

sentences.hanzi: 在物理实验中，我们需要测量物体受到的作用力。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 wu4 li3 shi2 yan4 zhong1, wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 ce4 liang2 wu4 ti3 shou4 dao4 de5 zuo4 yong4 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 물리 실험에서 우리는 물체가 받는 작용력을 측정해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: In a physics experiment, we need to measure the acting force on an object.

meaningEn: neighbors; people living nearby

sentences.hanzi: 逢年过节，左邻右舍都会互相来往问候。
sentences.pinyin: feng2 nian2 guo4 jie2, zuo3 lin2 you4 she4 dou1 hui4 hu4 xiang1 lai2 wang3 wen4 hou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 명절이 되면 이웃 사람들은 서로 오가며 안부를 묻곤 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: During holidays and festivals, neighbors visit one another and exchange greetings.

meaningEn: to have an informal discussion; symposium; round-table talk

sentences.hanzi: 会后，大家围坐在一起继续座谈交流。
sentences.pinyin: hui4 hou4, da4 jia1 wei2 zuo4 zai4 yi4 qi3 ji4 xu4 zuo4 tan2 jiao1 liu2.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의가 끝난 뒤 모두가 둘러앉아 계속 좌담하며 의견을 나누었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the meeting, everyone sat together and continued their round-table discussion.

meaningEn: workshop; handicraft shop

sentences.hanzi: 这家老作坊至今还保留着传统的手工制作方式。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jia1 lao3 zuo1 fang1 zhi4 jin1 hai2 bao3 liu2 zhe5 chuan2 tong3 de5 shou3 gong1 zhi4 zuo4 fang1 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 오래된 공방은 지금까지도 전통적인 수공 제작 방식을 간직하고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: This old workshop still preserves the traditional handmade production method to this day.

meaningEn: to be a guest; to stay as a guest

sentences.hanzi: 他小时候常去外婆家作客，一住就是好几天。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 xiao3 shi2 hou4 chang2 qu4 wai4 po2 jia1 zuo4 ke4, yi2 zhu4 jiu4 shi4 hao3 ji3 tian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 어릴 때 외할머니 댁에 자주 손님으로 가서 한 번 가면 며칠씩 지내곤 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: When he was little, he often stayed as a guest at his grandmother’s house for several days at a time.

meaningEn: to sit by and do nothing; to look on without intervening

sentences.hanzi: 看到有人遇到困难，我们不能坐视不管。
sentences.pinyin: kan4 dao4 you3 ren2 yu4 dao4 kun4 nan2, wo3 men5 bu4 neng2 zuo4 shi4 bu4 guan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 누군가가 어려움을 겪는 것을 보면 우리는 수수방관해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When we see someone in difficulty, we must not simply stand by and do nothing.

meaningEn: to check and attack; to intercept and strike; blocking action

sentences.hanzi: 他们迅速组织力量，对来犯者进行阻击。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 men5 xun4 su4 zu3 zhi1 li4 liang4, dui4 lai2 fan4 zhe3 jin4 xing2 zu3 ji1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그들은 신속히 역량을 조직해 침입자들을 저지 공격했다.
sentences.meaningEn: They quickly organized their forces to intercept and strike the intruders.

meaningEn: ancestral home; native place of one’s forefathers

sentences.hanzi: 虽然他出生在国外，但祖籍一直在这里。
sentences.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 chu1 sheng1 zai4 guo2 wai4, dan4 zu3 ji2 yi4 zhi2 zai4 zhe4 li3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 विदेश에서 태어났지만 조상의 본적은 줄곧 이곳이다.
sentences.meaningEn: Although he was born abroad, his ancestral home has always been here.

meaningEn: to keep someone company; to accompany

sentences.hanzi: 有朋友一路做伴，旅途就不会那么无聊了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 peng2 you3 yi2 lu4 zuo4 ban4, lv3 tu2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 na4 me5 wu2 liao2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 친구가 길 내내 함께해 주면 여행이 그렇게 지루하지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: When a friend keeps you company along the way, the journey does not feel so boring.

meaningEn: to enjoy the fruits of others’ labor without effort

sentences.hanzi: 想成功却不愿努力，只想坐享其成是不现实的。
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 cheng2 gong1 que4 bu4 yuan4 nu3 li4, zhi3 xiang3 zuo4 xiang3 qi2 cheng2 shi4 bu4 xian4 shi2 de5.
sentences.meaningKo: 성공은 바라면서 노력은 하지 않고 그저 남의 성과만 누리려는 것은 현실적이지 않다.
sentences.meaningEn: It is unrealistic to want success while refusing to work hard and merely hoping to enjoy the fruits of others’ labor.

meaningEn: to think over and over; to ponder from every angle

sentences.hanzi: 这件事我左思右想，还是觉得应该先和你商量。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 wo3 zuo3 si1 you4 xiang3, hai2 shi4 jue2 de5 ying1 gai1 xian1 he2 ni3 shang1 liang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 일을 이리저리 곰곰이 생각해 보니 역시 먼저 너와 상의해야겠다고 느꼈다.
sentences.meaningEn: After thinking this matter over and over, I still felt I should discuss it with you first.

meaningEn: to stand by and watch; to remain aloof and observe

sentences.hanzi: 面对团队的困难，领导不能只是作壁上观。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 tuan2 dui4 de5 kun4 nan2, ling3 dao3 bu4 neng2 zhi3 shi4 zuo4 bi4 shang4 guan1.
sentences.meaningKo: 팀의 어려움을 마주했을 때 리더는 그저 방관만 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When facing the team’s difficulties, a leader cannot merely stand by and watch.

meaningEn: to have a limited outlook; to look at the world from a narrow perspective

sentences.hanzi: 如果总待在自己的小圈子里，很容易变得坐井观天。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zong3 dai1 zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 xiao3 quan1 zi5 li3, hen3 rong2 yi4 bian4 de5 zuo4 jing3 guan1 tian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 항상 자기의 작은 세계에만 머물면 우물 안 개구리처럼 되기 쉽다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you always stay within your own small circle, it is easy to end up with a narrow outlook.

meaningEn: to wait passively for doom; to sit and await destruction

sentences.hanzi: 遇到危机时，我们不能坐以待毙，必须主动寻找办法。
sentences.pinyin: yu4 dao4 wei1 ji1 shi2, wo3 men5 bu4 neng2 zuo4 yi3 dai4 bi4, bi4 xu1 zhu3 dong4 xun2 zhao3 ban4 fa3.
sentences.meaningKo: 위기를 만났을 때 우리는 가만히 앉아 망하기를 기다릴 수 없고 반드시 적극적으로 방법을 찾아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: When facing a crisis, we cannot sit and await destruction; we must actively seek solutions.

meaningEn: to stop; to prevent; to hinder

sentences.hanzi: 如果发现危险情况，要及时采取措施加以阻止。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 fa1 xian4 wei1 xian3 qing2 kuang4, yao4 ji2 shi2 cai3 qu3 cuo4 shi1 jia1 yi3 zu3 zhi3.
sentences.meaningKo: 위험한 상황을 발견하면 제때 조치를 취해 그것을 막아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: If a dangerous situation is discovered, measures should be taken in time to prevent it.

meaningEn: to enjoy passively; to reap without effort

sentences.hanzi: 别人辛苦创造的成果，不能只想着坐享。
sentences.pinyin: bie2 ren2 xin1 ku3 chuang4 zao4 de5 cheng2 guo3, bu4 neng2 zhi3 xiang3 zhe5 zuo4 xiang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 남이 힘들게 만들어 낸 성과를 그저 가만히 누리기만 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: One should not think only of passively enjoying the results created through others’ hard work.

meaningEn: to obstruct secretly; to create obstacles deliberately

sentences.hanzi: 计划推进得不顺利，似乎有人在背后作梗。
sentences.pinyin: ji4 hua4 tui1 jin4 de5 bu4 shun4 li4, si4 hu1 you3 ren2 zai4 bei4 hou4 zuo4 geng3.
sentences.meaningKo: 계획이 순조롭게 진행되지 않는 것으로 보아 누군가 뒤에서 훼방을 놓는 듯하다.
sentences.meaningEn: The plan was not progressing smoothly, and it seemed that someone was secretly creating obstacles behind the scenes.

meaningEn: to organize; organization

sentences.hanzi: 学校组织了一次志愿服务活动，很多学生都报名参加了。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 zu3 zhi1 le5 yi2 ci4 zhi4 yuan4 fu2 wu4 huo2 dong4, hen3 duo1 xue2 sheng1 dou1 bao4 ming2 can1 jia1 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 학교는 자원봉사 활동을 한 차례 조직했고 많은 학생들이 신청해 참가했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The school organized a volunteer service activity, and many students signed up to take part.

meaningEn: to assemble; to put together

sentences.hanzi: 按照说明书一步一步来，很快就能把桌子组装好。
sentences.pinyin: an4 zhao4 shuo1 ming2 shu1 yi2 bu4 yi2 bu4 lai2, hen3 kuai4 jiu4 neng2 ba3 zhuo1 zi5 zu3 zhuang1 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 설명서를 따라 한 단계씩 하면 곧 책상을 조립할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: If you follow the instruction manual step by step, you will soon be able to assemble the desk.

meaningEn: handed down from ancestors; ancestral

sentences.hanzi: 这道菜的做法是他们家祖传下来的。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 cai4 de5 zuo4 fa3 shi4 ta1 men5 jia1 zu3 chuan2 xia4 lai2 de5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 요리의 조리법은 그 집안에서 대대로 전해 내려온 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The method for making this dish has been handed down in their family from generation to generation.

meaningEn: to exploit a loophole; to take advantage of gaps

sentences.hanzi: 有些人总想钻空子，占制度的便宜。
sentences.pinyin: you3 xie1 ren2 zong3 xiang3 zuan1 kong4 zi5, zhan4 zhi4 du4 de5 pian2 yi5.
sentences.meaningKo: 어떤 사람들은 늘 허점을 파고들어 제도의 빈틈을 이용해 이익을 얻으려 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Some people always try to exploit loopholes and take advantage of gaps in the system.

meaningEn: evil; crime; sinful; wicked

sentences.hanzi: 这种罪恶行为绝不能被原谅。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 zui4 e4 xing2 wei2 jue2 bu4 neng2 bei4 yuan2 liang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이런 죄악적인 행위는 결코 용서되어서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: This kind of evil behavior must never be forgiven.

meaningEn: style; manner; work style

sentences.hanzi: 他办事的作风一直都很严谨。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 ban4 shi4 de5 zuo4 feng1 yi4 zhi2 dou1 hen3 yan2 jin3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 일을 처리하는 방식이 늘 매우 엄밀하다.
sentences.meaningEn: His style of handling affairs has always been very rigorous.

meaningEn: effect; function; role; to act on

sentences.hanzi: 阳光对植物的生长起着重要作用。
sentences.pinyin: yang2 guang1 dui4 zhi2 wu4 de5 sheng1 zhang3 qi3 zhe5 zhong4 yao4 zuo4 yong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 햇빛은 식물의 성장에 중요한 역할을 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Sunlight plays an important role in plant growth.

meaningEn: to corroborate; supporting evidence

sentences.hanzi: 这些数据可以作为结论的重要佐证。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shu4 ju4 ke3 yi3 zuo4 wei2 jie2 lun4 de5 zhong4 yao4 zuo3 zheng4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 자료들은 결론을 뒷받침하는 중요한 보조 증거가 될 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: These data can serve as important supporting evidence for the conclusion.

meaningEn: to oversee in person; to direct from one's post

sentences.hanzi: 为了确保活动顺利进行，他亲自坐镇现场。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 que4 bao3 huo2 dong4 shun4 li4 jin4 xing2, ta1 qin1 zi4 zuo4 zhen4 xian4 chang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 행사가 순조롭게 진행되도록 그는 직접 현장을 지키며 총괄했다.
sentences.meaningEn: To ensure the event went smoothly, he personally oversaw the scene.

meaningEn: to set up; to form; to organize

sentences.hanzi: 公司最近组建了一支新的研发团队。
sentences.pinyin: gong1 si1 zui4 jin4 zu3 jian4 le5 yi4 zhi1 xin1 de5 yan2 fa1 tuan2 dui4.
sentences.meaningKo: 회사는 최근 새로운 연구개발 팀 하나를 꾸렸다.
sentences.meaningEn: The company recently set up a new research and development team.

meaningEn: ancestors; forefathers; older generations

sentences.hanzi: 祖辈留下来的手艺，至今还在这个村子里传承着。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 bei4 liu2 xia4 lai2 de5 shou3 yi4, zhi4 jin1 hai2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 cun1 zi5 li3 chuan2 cheng2 zhe5.
sentences.meaningKo: 조상들이 남긴 기술은 지금까지도 이 마을에서 이어지고 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: The craft handed down by the ancestors is still being passed on in this village today.

meaningEn: heart-piercing; excruciating; deeply painful

sentences.hanzi: 伤口传来一阵钻心的疼痛，让他直冒冷汗。
sentences.pinyin: shang1 kou3 chuan2 lai2 yi2 zhen4 zuan1 xin1 de5 teng2 tong4, rang4 ta1 zhi2 mao4 leng3 han4.
sentences.meaningKo: 상처에서 가슴을 후비는 듯한 통증이 밀려와 그는 식은땀을 흘렸다.
sentences.meaningEn: A burst of excruciating pain came from the wound, making him break out in a cold sweat.

meaningEn: drunk; tipsy; in a drunken state

sentences.hanzi: 他昨晚醉醺醺地回到家，连路都走不稳。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo2 wan3 zui4 xun1 xun1 di5 hui2 dao4 jia1, lian2 lu4 dou1 zou3 bu4 wen3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 어젯밤 술에 잔뜩 취해 집에 돌아와 길도 제대로 걷지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He came home drunk last night and could not even walk steadily.

meaningEn: charge; accusation; criminal count

sentences.hanzi: 案件还在调查中，目前不能轻易下结论或确定罪名。
sentences.pinyin: an4 jian4 hai2 zai4 diao4 cha2 zhong1, mu4 qian2 bu4 neng2 qing1 yi4 xia4 jie2 lun4 huo4 que4 ding4 zui4 ming2.
sentences.meaningKo: 사건은 아직 조사 중이어서 현재로서는 쉽게 결론을 내리거나 죄명을 확정할 수 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: The case is still under investigation, so no conclusion or formal charge can be determined lightly at present.

sentences.meaningKo: 믿을 만한 사람이 보증을 서지 않으면 이 신청은 통과되기 어렵다.
sentences.meaningEn: If no reliable person stands surety, this application will be hard to approve.

meaningEn: to set fruit; fruit setting

sentences.hanzi: 今年天气适宜，这批果树坐果情况很好。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 tian1 qi4 shi4 yi2, zhe4 pi1 guo3 shu4 zuo4 guo3 qing2 kuang4 hen3 hao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 올해는 날씨가 알맞아서 이 과수들의 착과 상태가 매우 좋다.
sentences.meaningEn: The weather this year has been suitable, and the fruit-setting condition of these fruit trees is very good.

meaningEn: to fix a price; to assess a value

sentences.hanzi: 这些旧家具需要先作价，再决定是否出售。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jiu4 jia1 ju4 xu1 yao4 xian1 zuo4 jia4, zai4 jue2 ding4 shi4 fou3 chu1 shou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 낡은 가구들은 먼저 값을 산정한 뒤 판매 여부를 결정해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: These old pieces of furniture need to be appraised first before deciding whether to sell them.

meaningEn: to solicit contributions; editorial collection of manuscripts

sentences.hanzi: 为了出版特刊，编辑部最近一直在忙着组稿。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 chu1 ban3 te4 kan1, bian1 ji2 bu4 zui4 jin4 yi4 zhi2 zai4 mang2 zhe5 zu3 gao3.
sentences.meaningKo: 특집호를 출판하기 위해 편집부는 최근 계속 원고를 모으느라 바빴다.
sentences.meaningEn: To publish the special issue, the editorial department has recently been busy soliciting contributions.

meaningEn: to keep company; to accompany

sentences.hanzi: 夜路不好走，有个人作伴儿总会安心一些。
sentences.pinyin: ye4 lu4 bu4 hao3 zou3, you3 ge4 ren2 zuo4 ban4 er2 zong3 hui4 an1 xin1 yi4 xie1.
sentences.meaningKo: 밤길은 걷기 좋지 않아서 누군가 함께 있어 주면 훨씬 안심이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: It is not easy to walk at night, so having someone accompany you is always more reassuring.

meaningEn: to be besieged by worries; to be trapped in anxiety

sentences.hanzi: 问题一个接一个地来，让他整天坐困愁城。
sentences.pinyin: wen4 ti2 yi2 ge4 jie1 yi2 ge4 di5 lai2, rang4 ta1 zheng3 tian1 zuo4 kun4 chou2 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 문제가 하나씩 계속 닥쳐와서 그는 하루 종일 근심 걱정에 사로잡혀 있었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Problems kept coming one after another, leaving him besieged by worries all day long.

meaningEn: to do evil; to commit wrongs

sentences.hanzi: 无论是谁作恶，都应该受到应有的惩罚。
sentences.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 shui2 zuo4 e4, dou1 ying1 gai1 shou4 dao4 ying1 you3 de5 cheng2 fa2.
sentences.meaningKo: 누가 악행을 저지르든 마땅한 처벌을 받아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: No matter who does evil, they should receive the punishment they deserve.

meaningEn: to be unable to cope; to be at one's wit's end; to be overstretched
meaningKo: 이리저리 메우느라 여유가 없다; 감당하기 벅차다

sentences.hanzi: 同时处理这么多任务，让他有些左支右绌。
sentences.pinyin: tong2 shi2 chu3 li3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren4 wu5, rang4 ta1 you3 xie1 zuo3 zhi1 you4 chu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이렇게 많은 업무를 동시에 처리하자 그는 다소 버거워하며 이리저리 메우는 처지가 되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: Handling so many tasks at the same time left him somewhat overstretched.

meaningEn: to remain morally upright and composed in temptation

sentences.hanzi: 面对诱惑还能坐怀不乱，确实很不容易。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 you4 huo4 hai2 neng2 zuo4 huai2 bu4 luan4, que4 shi2 hen3 bu4 rong2 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 유혹을 마주하고도 마음이 흐트러지지 않는 것은 확실히 쉬운 일이 아니다.
sentences.meaningEn: It is indeed not easy to remain composed and upright even in the face of temptation.

meaningEn: to nurture; to cultivate and educate

sentences.hanzi: 教育的价值之一，就是长期作育社会所需要的人才。
sentences.pinyin: jiao4 yu4 de5 jia4 zhi2 zhi1 yi1, jiu4 shi4 chang2 qi1 zuo4 yu4 she4 hui4 suo3 xu1 yao4 de5 ren2 cai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 교육의 가치 중 하나는 사회가 필요로 하는 인재를 장기적으로 길러 내는 데 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: One of the values of education is to nurture the talent needed by society over the long term.

meaningEn: cheating behavior; fraudulent conduct

sentences.hanzi: 学校将严肃处理一切作弊行为。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 jiang1 yan2 su4 chu3 li3 yi2 qie4 zuo4 bi4 xing2 wei2.
sentences.meaningKo: 학교는 모든 부정행위를 엄중하게 처리할 것이다.
sentences.meaningEn: The school will deal seriously with all cheating behavior.

meaningEn: problem of work style; conduct issue

sentences.hanzi: 会议上重点讨论了管理中的作风问题。
sentences.pinyin: hui4 yi4 shang4 zhong4 dian3 tao3 lun4 le5 guan3 li3 zhong1 de5 zuo4 feng1 wen4 ti2.
sentences.meaningKo: 회의에서는 관리 과정의 작풍 문제를 중점적으로 논의했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The meeting focused on discussing work-style problems in management.

meaningEn: coordinate system

sentences.hanzi: 在这个坐标系中，我们可以更清楚地分析变化趋势。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 zuo4 biao1 xi4 zhong1, wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 geng4 qing1 chu3 di5 fen1 xi1 bian4 hua4 qu1 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 좌표계에서는 변화 추세를 더 분명하게 분석할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: In this coordinate system, we can analyze the trend of change more clearly.

meaningEn: to take a vehicle; to ride in a car/bus/train

sentences.hanzi: 从这里到市中心，坐车大概需要半个小时。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 li3 dao4 shi4 zhong1 xin1, zuo4 che1 da4 gai4 xu1 yao4 ban4 ge4 xiao3 shi2.
sentences.meaningKo: 여기서 시내 중심까지는 차를 타면 대략 30분 정도 걸린다.
sentences.meaningEn: From here to the city center, it takes about half an hour by car.

meaningEn: to long for even in one's dreams; to desperately wish for

sentences.hanzi: 他做梦都想去看看那座一直向往的城市。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 meng4 dou1 xiang3 qu4 kan4 kan5 na4 zuo4 yi4 zhi2 xiang4 wang3 de5 cheng2 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 늘 동경하던 그 도시를 꿈에서도 가 보고 싶어 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He longed even in his dreams to see that city he had always admired.

meaningEn: group category; division

sentences.hanzi: 报名时请先确认自己参加的是哪个组别。
sentences.pinyin: bao4 ming2 shi2 qing3 xian1 que4 ren4 zi4 ji3 can1 jia1 de5 shi4 na3 ge4 zu3 bie2.
sentences.meaningKo: 신청할 때 먼저 자신이 어느 부문에 참가하는지 확인해 주세요.
sentences.meaningEn: When registering, please first confirm which division you are participating in.

meaningEn: grandmother (paternal)

sentences.hanzi: 我小时候常听祖母讲过去的故事。
sentences.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 shi2 hou4 chang2 ting1 zu3 mu3 jiang3 guo4 qu4 de5 gu4 shi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 나는 어릴 때 할머니께서 들려주시던 옛날 이야기를 자주 들었다.
sentences.meaningEn: When I was young, I often listened to my grandmother tell stories about the past.

meaningEn: to draw a graph; to make a diagram

sentences.hanzi: 根据这些数据作图后，规律就更容易看出来了。
sentences.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 xie1 shu4 ju4 zuo4 tu2 hou4, gui1 lv4 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 kan4 chu1 lai2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 데이터로 도표를 그리고 나면 규칙성이 더 쉽게 드러난다.
sentences.meaningEn: After drawing a graph based on these data, the pattern becomes easier to see.

meaningEn: schedule; daily timetable

sentences.hanzi: 教室门口贴着新的作息表，大家可以去看看。
sentences.pinyin: jiao4 shi4 men2 kou3 tie1 zhe5 xin1 de5 zuo4 xi1 biao3, da4 jia1 ke3 yi3 qu4 kan4 kan5.
sentences.meaningKo: 교실 문 앞에 새로운 생활 시간표가 붙어 있으니 모두 가서 볼 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: A new daily timetable is posted at the classroom door, and everyone can go take a look.

meaningEn: right-hand man; trusted assistant; both hands

sentences.hanzi: 他是经理最信任的左右手，很多事情都会先和他商量。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 shi4 jing1 li3 zui4 xin4 ren4 de5 zuo3 you4 shou3, hen3 duo1 shi4 qing2 dou1 hui4 xian1 he2 ta1 shang1 liang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 매니저가 가장 신뢰하는 최측근이라 많은 일을 먼저 그와 상의한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He is the manager’s most trusted right-hand man, and many matters are discussed with him first.

meaningEn: sleep and rest habits; daily routine habits
meaningKo: 생활 습관; 수면 및 생활 리듬 습관

sentences.hanzi: 长期保持良好的作息习惯，对健康非常重要。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 qi1 bao3 chi2 liang2 hao3 de5 zuo4 xi1 xi2 guan4, dui4 jian4 kang1 fei1 chang2 zhong4 yao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 오랫동안 좋은 생활 습관을 유지하는 것은 건강에 매우 중요하다.
sentences.meaningEn: Maintaining good daily routine habits over the long term is very important for health.

meaningEn: battle plan; operational plan

sentences.hanzi: 行动之前，必须先把作战计划讨论清楚。
sentences.pinyin: xing2 dong4 zhi1 qian2, bi4 xu1 xian1 ba3 zuo4 zhan4 ji4 hua4 tao3 lun4 qing1 chu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 행동에 앞서 먼저 작전 계획을 분명히 논의해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before taking action, the operational plan must first be discussed clearly.

meaningEn: to sit and wait

sentences.hanzi: 光坐等机会出现是不够的，还得主动争取。
sentences.pinyin: guang1 zuo4 deng3 ji1 hui4 chu1 xian4 shi4 bu4 gou4 de5, hai2 dei3 zhu3 dong4 zheng1 qu3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그저 가만히 앉아 기회가 오기만 기다려서는 부족하고 스스로 적극적으로 쟁취해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Simply sitting and waiting for opportunities to appear is not enough; one must actively strive for them.

meaningEn: style of conduct; manner; way of doing things

sentences.hanzi: 他的做派一向低调，从不喜欢张扬自己。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 pai4 yi2 xiang4 di1 diao4, cong2 bu4 xi3 huan1 zhang1 yang2 zi4 ji3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 처신 방식은 늘 낮고 조용해서 자신을 드러내는 것을 좋아하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: His style has always been low-key, and he never likes to show himself off.

meaningEn: suite (music)

sentences.hanzi: 这部组曲由几个风格不同的乐章组成。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 zu3 qu3 you2 ji3 ge4 feng1 ge2 bu4 tong2 de5 yue4 zhang1 zu3 cheng2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 모음곡은 서로 다른 분위기의 몇 개 악장으로 이루어져 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: This suite is composed of several movements with different styles.

meaningEn: to make as if to leave

sentences.hanzi: 他只是作势要走，其实还想再听听大家的意见。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 zuo4 shi4 yao4 zou3, qi2 shi2 hai2 xiang3 zai4 ting1 ting1 da4 jia1 de5 yi4 jian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 단지 가는 척했을 뿐 사실은 모두의 의견을 더 들어 보고 싶어 했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He only made as if to leave; in fact, he still wanted to hear everyone’s opinions.

meaningEn: to possess in abundance; to sit on

sentences.hanzi: 这家公司坐拥大量资源，因此发展得很快。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jia1 gong1 si1 zuo4 yong1 da4 liang4 zi1 yuan2, yin1 ci3 fa1 zhan3 de5 hen3 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 회사는 많은 자원을 보유하고 있어서 발전이 매우 빠르다.
sentences.meaningEn: This company possesses abundant resources, so it has developed very quickly.

meaningEn: to preside over one region; to command one area in person

sentences.hanzi: 他多年坐镇一方，处理事情一直很稳妥。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 duo1 nian2 zuo4 zhen4 yi4 fang1, chu3 li3 shi4 qing2 yi4 zhi2 hen3 wen3 tuo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 여러 해 동안 한 지역을 지키며 일을 처리해 왔고 늘 매우 안정적이었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He presided over one area for many years and always handled affairs very steadily.

meaningEn: to make a contribution

sentences.hanzi: 每个人都可以在自己的岗位上作出贡献。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 ke3 yi3 zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 gang3 wei4 shang4 zuo4 chu1 gong4 xian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 사람마다 자기 자리에서 공헌할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone can make a contribution in their own position.

meaningEn: right-hand men; trusted assistants

sentences.hanzi: 这两位同事是经理最得力的左膀右臂。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 wei4 tong2 shi4 shi4 jing1 li3 zui4 de2 li4 de5 zuo3 bang3 you4 bi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 두 동료는 매니저가 가장 믿고 의지하는 핵심 참모들이다.
sentences.meaningEn: These two colleagues are the manager’s most capable and trusted assistants.

meaningEn: to be the banker; to manipulate the market

sentences.hanzi: 在某些不规范的交易中，可能有人暗中坐庄。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 mou3 xie1 bu4 gui1 fan4 de5 jiao1 yi4 zhong1, ke3 neng2 you3 ren2 an4 zhong1 zuo4 zhuang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일부 불규범한 거래에서는 누군가 뒤에서 판을 조종할 가능성이 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: In some irregular transactions, someone may be manipulating things behind the scenes.

meaningEn: to keep accounts; to do bookkeeping

sentences.hanzi: 月底之前，财务人员要把这个月的账都做完。
sentences.pinyin: yue4 di3 zhi1 qian2, cai2 wu4 ren2 yuan2 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge4 yue4 de5 zhang4 dou1 zuo4 wan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 월말 전에 재무 담당자는 이번 달 장부를 모두 정리해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Before the end of the month, the finance staff must finish all the bookkeeping for this month.

meaningEn: a sidelined person; one left out in the cold

sentences.hanzi: 每个团队里都不该让任何人长期成为坐冷板凳的人。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 ge4 tuan2 dui4 li3 dou1 bu4 gai1 rang4 ren4 he2 ren2 chang2 qi1 cheng2 wei2 zuo4 leng3 ban3 deng4 de5 ren2.
sentences.meaningKo: 어떤 팀에서든 누구도 오랫동안 소외된 사람이 되게 해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: In any team, no one should be left sidelined for a long time.

meaningEn: upright in conduct; decent in style

sentences.hanzi: 他一向作风正派，所以大家都很信任他。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yi2 xiang4 zuo4 feng1 zheng4 pai4, suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 xin4 ren4 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 늘 품행이 바르기 때문에 모두가 그를 매우 신뢰한다.
sentences.meaningEn: He has always been upright in conduct, so everyone trusts him very much.

meaningEn: well organized; tightly organized

sentences.hanzi: 这次活动安排得井井有条，说明组织非常严密。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 an1 pai2 de5 jing3 jing3 you3 tiao2, shuo1 ming2 zu3 zhi1 fei1 chang2 yan2 mi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이번 행사는 질서정연하게 진행되어 조직이 매우 치밀했다는 것을 보여 준다.
sentences.meaningEn: This event was arranged in an orderly way, showing that the organization was very tight and well managed.

meaningEn: to influence the situation; to sway the situation

sentences.hanzi: 一个关键决定往往足以左右整个局势的发展。
sentences.pinyin: yi2 ge4 guan1 jian4 jue2 ding4 wang3 wang3 zu2 yi3 zuo3 you4 zheng3 ge4 ju2 shi4 de5 fa1 zhan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 하나의 중요한 결정은 흔히 전체 정세의 전개를 좌우하기에 충분하다.
sentences.meaningEn: A key decision is often enough to influence the development of the whole situation.

meaningEn: manuscript solicitation work; editorial collection work

sentences.hanzi: 为了保证进度，组稿工作必须提前展开。
sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 bao3 zheng4 jin4 du4, zu3 gao3 gong1 zuo4 bi4 xu1 ti2 qian2 zhan3 kai1.
sentences.meaningKo: 일정 진도를 보장하기 위해 원고 모집 업무는 미리 시작되어야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To ensure progress, the work of soliciting manuscripts must begin in advance.

meaningEn: to discuss principles in the abstract; to talk without action

sentences.hanzi: 解决实际问题不能只坐而论道，还要付诸行动。
sentences.pinyin: jie3 jue2 shi2 ji4 wen4 ti2 bu4 neng2 zhi3 zuo4 er2 lun4 dao4, hai2 yao4 fu4 zhu1 xing2 dong4.
sentences.meaningKo: 실제 문제를 해결하려면 그저 앉아서 이론만 논해서는 안 되고 행동으로 옮겨야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: To solve real problems, one cannot merely discuss theories in the abstract; one must also take action.

meaningEn: to wield power arrogantly; to abuse power for personal gain

sentences.hanzi: 掌握权力的人更不应该作威作福。
sentences.pinyin: zhang3 wo4 quan2 li4 de5 ren2 geng4 bu4 ying1 gai1 zuo4 wei1 zuo4 fu2.
sentences.meaningKo: 권력을 쥔 사람일수록 더욱 권세를 휘두르거나 권력을 남용해서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Those who hold power should all the more refrain from wielding it arrogantly or abusing it for personal gain.

meaningEn: honored guest; guest of honor

sentences.hanzi: 这位老先生一直是这里的座上宾，大家都很尊敬他。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 lao3 xian1 sheng5 yi4 zhi2 shi4 zhe4 li3 de5 zuo4 shang4 bin1, da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 zun1 jing4 ta1.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 노신사는 이곳의 귀빈으로 늘 대접받으며 모두가 그를 매우 존경한다.
sentences.meaningEn: This elderly gentleman has always been an honored guest here, and everyone respects him very much.

meaningEn: to make up one's mind; to decide

sentences.hanzi: 这件事太复杂了，我一时还作不了主意。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 tai4 fu4 za2 le5, wo3 yi2 shi2 hai2 zuo4 bu4 liao3 zhu3 yi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 일은 너무 복잡해서 나는 당장 결정을 내릴 수가 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: This matter is too complicated, and I cannot make up my mind right away.

meaningEn: work-rest system; schedule system

sentences.hanzi: 学校实行新的作息制度以后，学生的休息时间更合理了。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 shi2 xing2 xin1 de5 zuo4 xi1 zhi4 du4 yi3 hou4, xue2 sheng1 de5 xiu1 xi5 shi2 jian1 geng4 he2 li3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 학교가 새로운 생활 시간 제도를 시행한 뒤 학생들의 휴식 시간이 더 합리적으로 바뀌었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After the school implemented a new work-rest schedule, the students' rest time became more reasonable.

meaningEn: to get along well everywhere; to be tactful and adaptable

sentences.hanzi: 他待人圆融，所以无论在哪个环境里都能左右逢源。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 dai4 ren2 yuan2 rong2, suo3 yi3 wu2 lun4 zai4 na3 ge4 huan2 jing4 li3 dou1 neng2 zuo3 you4 feng2 yuan2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 사람을 원만하게 대하므로 어느 환경에서든 두루 잘 어울린다.
sentences.meaningEn: He treats people tactfully, so he can get along well in any environment.

meaningEn: to make a sound; to speak up

sentences.hanzi: 屋里太安静了，谁也没有作声。
sentences.pinyin: wu1 li3 tai4 an1 jing4 le5, shui2 ye3 mei2 you3 zuo4 sheng1.
sentences.meaningKo: 방 안이 너무 조용해서 누구도 소리를 내지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: It was so quiet in the room that no one made a sound.

meaningEn: to lose through inaction; to miss

sentences.hanzi: 如果总是犹豫，就可能坐失很多机会。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zong3 shi4 you2 yu4, jiu4 ke3 neng2 zuo4 shi1 hen3 duo1 ji1 hui4.
sentences.meaningKo: 늘 망설이기만 하면 많은 기회를 가만히 있다가 놓칠 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: If one always hesitates, one may lose many opportunities through inaction.

meaningEn: organizational life; group activities within an organization

sentences.hanzi: 积极参加组织生活，有助于增强团队归属感。
sentences.pinyin: ji1 ji2 can1 jia1 zu3 zhi1 sheng1 huo2, you3 zhu4 yu2 zeng1 qiang2 tuan2 dui4 gui1 shu3 gan3.
sentences.meaningKo: 조직 생활에 적극 참여하는 것은 팀 소속감을 높이는 데 도움이 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Actively participating in organizational life helps strengthen a sense of team belonging.

meaningEn: way of doing; method; practice

sentences.hanzi: 这种作法虽然省事，但不一定最合理。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 zuo4 fa3 sui1 ran2 sheng3 shi4, dan4 bu4 yi2 ding4 zui4 he2 li3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이런 방식은 비록 수고를 덜 수 있지만 반드시 가장 합리적인 것은 아니다.
sentences.meaningEn: Although this method saves trouble, it is not necessarily the most reasonable one.

meaningEn: to make an issue of; to make use of something for one's own ends

sentences.hanzi: 不要总拿别人的小失误来做文章。
sentences.pinyin: bu2 yao4 zong3 na2 bie2 ren2 de5 xiao3 shi1 wu4 lai2 zuo4 wen2 zhang1.
sentences.meaningKo: 남의 작은 실수를 늘 빌미로 삼아 문제 삼지 마라.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not always make an issue out of other people's small mistakes.

meaningEn: to possess and enjoy existing achievements

sentences.hanzi: 企业不能只坐拥其成，还要不断创新。
sentences.pinyin: qi4 ye4 bu4 neng2 zhi3 zuo4 yong1 qi2 cheng2, hai2 yao4 bu4 duan4 chuang4 xin1.
sentences.meaningKo: 기업은 이미 이룬 성과에만 안주해서는 안 되고 계속 혁신해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: An enterprise cannot simply rest on and enjoy its existing achievements; it must continue to innovate.

meaningEn: to be demoted; demotion

sentences.hanzi: 他因为管理失误而被左迁到分部工作。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 yin1 wei4 guan3 li3 shi1 wu4 er2 bei4 zuo3 qian1 dao4 fen1 bu4 gong1 zuo4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 관리상의 실수로 지사 근무로 좌천되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: He was demoted to work at a branch office because of a management mistake.

meaningEn: composer

sentences.hanzi: 这位作曲家以擅长写抒情旋律而闻名。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 zuo4 qu3 jia1 yi3 shan4 chang2 xie3 shu1 qing2 xuan2 lv4 er2 wen2 ming2.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 작곡가는 서정적인 선율을 잘 쓰는 것으로 유명하다.
sentences.meaningEn: This composer is famous for being skilled at writing lyrical melodies.

meaningEn: shopkeeper doing business from a fixed location

sentences.hanzi: 和流动摊贩不同，坐商通常有固定的经营场所。
sentences.pinyin: he2 liu2 dong4 tan1 fan4 bu4 tong2, zuo4 shang1 tong1 chang2 you3 gu4 ding4 de5 jing1 ying2 chang3 suo3.
sentences.meaningKo: 이동 상인과 달리 점포 상인은 보통 고정된 영업 장소가 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Unlike itinerant vendors, shopkeepers usually have a fixed place of business.

meaningEn: to form a group; group tour/team

sentences.hanzi: 不少游客喜欢组团出行，这样更方便也更热闹。
sentences.pinyin: bu4 shao3 you2 ke4 xi3 huan1 zu3 tuan2 chu1 xing2, zhe4 yang4 geng4 fang1 bian4 ye3 geng4 re4 nao5.
sentences.meaningKo: 많은 여행객들은 단체를 이루어 이동하는 것을 좋아하는데, 그렇게 하면 더 편리하고 더 즐겁다.
sentences.meaningEn: Many travelers like to go out in groups, because it is more convenient and more lively that way.

meaningEn: to do business; to trade

sentences.hanzi: 他年轻时就跟着家里人学着做买卖。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 nian2 qing1 shi2 jiu4 gen1 zhe5 jia1 li3 ren2 xue2 zhe5 zuo4 mai3 mai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 젊을 때부터 집안 어른들을 따라 장사하는 법을 배웠다.
sentences.meaningEn: When he was young, he learned how to do business by following the elders in his family.

meaningEn: a person who abuses power arrogantly

sentences.hanzi: 群众最反感的，就是那些作威作福的人。
sentences.pinyin: qun2 zhong4 zui4 fan3 gan3 de5, jiu4 shi4 na4 xie1 zuo4 wei1 zuo4 fu2 de5 ren2.
sentences.meaningKo: 대중이 가장 반감을 느끼는 것은 바로 권세를 휘두르는 사람들이다.
sentences.meaningEn: What the public resents most are those who wield power arrogantly.

meaningEn: to dodge left and right; to evade repeatedly

sentences.hanzi: 面对大家的追问，他一直左躲右闪，不肯正面回答。
sentences.pinyin: mian4 dui4 da4 jia1 de5 zhui1 wen4, ta1 yi4 zhi2 zuo3 duo3 you4 shan3, bu4 ken3 zheng4 mian4 hui2 da2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 모두의 추궁 앞에서 계속 이리저리 피하며 정면으로 대답하려 하지 않았다.
sentences.meaningEn: Faced with everyone’s questioning, he kept dodging and refused to answer directly.

meaningEn: to live as a guest in a foreign place; to be away from one's hometown

sentences.hanzi: 多年作客他乡之后，他越来越想念故乡的味道。
sentences.pinyin: duo1 nian2 zuo4 ke4 ta1 xiang1 zhi1 hou4, ta1 yue4 lai2 yue4 xiang3 nian4 gu4 xiang1 de5 wei4 dao4.
sentences.meaningKo: 여러 해 동안 타향살이를 한 뒤 그는 고향의 맛을 점점 더 그리워하게 되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After living away from home for many years, he missed the taste of his hometown more and more.

meaningEn: to fill all seats; to be fully occupied with seated people

sentences.hanzi: 电影开场前十分钟，前排已经差不多坐满了。
sentences.pinyin: dian4 ying3 kai1 chang3 qian2 shi2 fen1 zhong1, qian2 pai2 yi3 jing1 cha4 bu4 duo1 zuo4 man3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 영화가 시작되기 10분 전, 앞줄 자리는 거의 다 찼다.
sentences.meaningEn: Ten minutes before the movie started, the front rows were almost completely filled.

meaningEn: team member; group member

sentences.hanzi: 每位组员都需要明确自己的任务分工。
sentences.pinyin: mei3 wei4 zu3 yuan2 dou1 xu1 yao4 ming2 que4 zi4 ji3 de5 ren4 wu5 fen1 gong1.
sentences.meaningKo: 각 조원은 자신의 업무 분담을 분명히 알아야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Each team member needs to be clear about their own task division.

meaningEn: to celebrate an elder's birthday

sentences.hanzi: 今年全家人准备回老家给爷爷做寿。
sentences.pinyin: jin1 nian2 quan2 jia1 ren2 zhun3 bei4 hui2 lao3 jia1 gei3 ye2 ye5 zuo4 shou4.
sentences.meaningKo: 올해 온 가족은 고향에 돌아가 할아버지 생신 잔치를 해 드릴 예정이다.
sentences.meaningEn: This year the whole family plans to return to their hometown to celebrate Grandpa’s birthday.

meaningEn: the effect is obvious; markedly effective

sentences.hanzi: 经过一段时间使用后，这种方法的作用明显体现出来了。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yi2 duan4 shi2 jian1 shi3 yong4 hou4, zhe4 zhong3 fang1 fa3 de5 zuo4 yong4 ming2 xian3 ti3 xian4 chu1 lai2 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 한동안 사용한 뒤 이 방법의 효과가 뚜렷하게 드러났다.
sentences.meaningEn: After being used for a period of time, the effect of this method became clearly apparent.

meaningEn: to go in one ear and out the other
meaningKo: 한 귀로 듣고 한 귀로 흘리다

sentences.hanzi: 老师讲的话你别总是左耳进右耳出，要认真记住。
sentences.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jiang3 de5 hua4 ni3 bie2 zong3 shi4 zuo3 er3 jin4 you4 er3 chu1, yao4 ren4 zhen1 ji4 zhu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 선생님 말씀을 늘 한 귀로 듣고 한 귀로 흘리지 말고 진지하게 기억해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: Do not always let the teacher’s words go in one ear and out the other; you should remember them seriously.

meaningEn: irregular routine; disordered work-rest schedule

sentences.hanzi: 长期熬夜会让作息紊乱，影响身体状态。
sentences.pinyin: chang2 qi1 ao2 ye4 hui4 rang4 zuo4 xi1 wen3 luan4, ying3 xiang3 shen1 ti3 zhuang4 tai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 오랫동안 밤을 새우면 생활 리듬이 흐트러져 몸 상태에 영향을 준다.
sentences.meaningEn: Staying up late for a long time can disrupt one’s routine and affect physical condition.

meaningEn: to take a plane; to fly by airplane

sentences.hanzi: 从这里去南方，坐飞机会节省很多时间。
sentences.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 li3 qu4 nan2 fang1, zuo4 fei1 ji1 hui4 jie2 sheng3 hen3 duo1 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 여기서 남쪽으로 갈 때는 비행기를 타면 시간을 많이 절약할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Going south from here by plane can save a lot of time.

meaningEn: well organized; orderly

sentences.hanzi: 现场安排得组织有序，整个流程推进得很顺畅。
sentences.pinyin: xian4 chang3 an1 pai2 de5 zu3 zhi1 you3 xu4, zheng3 ge4 liu2 cheng2 tui1 jin4 de5 hen3 shun4 chang4.
sentences.meaningKo: 현장 배치가 질서정연해서 전체 절차가 매우 순조롭게 진행되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: The site was arranged in an orderly way, and the whole process moved forward very smoothly.

meaningEn: to draw a conclusion

sentences.hanzi: 在证据还不充分的时候，不要急着做结论。
sentences.pinyin: zai4 zheng4 ju4 hai2 bu4 chong1 fen4 de5 shi2 hou4, bu2 yao4 ji2 zhe5 zuo4 jie2 lun4.
sentences.meaningKo: 증거가 아직 충분하지 않을 때는 서둘러 결론을 내려서는 안 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: When the evidence is still insufficient, one should not rush to draw a conclusion.

meaningEn: to take the elevator

sentences.hanzi: 楼层太高了，还是坐电梯比较省力。
sentences.pinyin: lou2 ceng2 tai4 gao1 le5, hai2 shi4 zuo4 dian4 ti1 bi3 jiao4 sheng3 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 층이 너무 높아서 역시 엘리베이터를 타는 편이 더 수월하다.
sentences.meaningEn: The floor is too high, so it is easier to take the elevator.

meaningEn: to make a comparison

sentences.hanzi: 把这两个方案放在一起作比较，差异就很明显了。
sentences.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 fang1 an4 fang4 zai4 yi4 qi3 zuo4 bi3 jiao4, cha1 yi4 jiu4 hen3 ming2 xian3 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 두 방안을 함께 놓고 비교해 보면 차이가 매우 뚜렷해진다.
sentences.meaningEn: If these two plans are compared side by side, the differences become very obvious.

meaningEn: organizing committee

sentences.hanzi: 有关比赛安排的最新通知，已经由组委会发布了。
sentences.pinyin: you3 guan1 bi3 sai4 an1 pai2 de5 zui4 xin1 tong1 zhi1, yi3 jing1 you2 zu3 wei3 hui4 fa1 bu4 le5.
sentences.meaningKo: 경기 운영과 관련된 최신 공지는 이미 조직위원회에서 발표했다.
sentences.meaningEn: The latest notice concerning the event arrangements has already been issued by the organizing committee.

meaningEn: to contribute; to make contributions

sentences.hanzi: 无论岗位大小，都有机会为社会做贡献。
sentences.pinyin: wu2 lun4 gang3 wei4 da4 xiao3, dou1 you3 ji1 hui4 wei4 she4 hui4 zuo4 gong4 xian4.
sentences.meaningKo: 직책의 크고 작음을 막론하고 누구나 사회에 기여할 기회가 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: Regardless of the size of one’s position, everyone has an opportunity to contribute to society.

meaningEn: to work; workmanship; handcraft quality

sentences.hanzi: 这件衣服做工很细，看得出下了不少功夫。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 yi1 fu5 zuo4 gong1 hen3 xi4, kan4 de5 chu1 xia4 le5 bu4 shao3 gong1 fu5.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 옷은 만듦새가 매우 섬세해서 적잖은 공을 들였다는 것이 보인다.
sentences.meaningEn: The workmanship of this piece of clothing is very fine, and it is clear that a lot of effort went into it.

meaningEn: to do manual work; to work at a task

sentences.hanzi: 他年轻时靠给人做活儿养活一家人。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 nian2 qing1 shi2 kao4 gei3 ren2 zuo4 huo2 er2 yang3 huo2 yi4 jia1 ren2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 젊었을 때 남의 일을 해 주며 가족을 부양했다.
sentences.meaningEn: When he was young, he supported his family by doing jobs for others.

meaningEn: to go to prison; to serve a prison sentence

sentences.hanzi: 违法犯罪的人终究要为自己的行为坐牢。
sentences.pinyin: wei2 fa3 fan4 zui4 de5 ren2 zhong1 jiu1 yao4 wei4 zi4 ji3 de5 xing2 wei2 zuo4 lao2.
sentences.meaningKo: 위법 범죄를 저지른 사람은 결국 자신의 행동에 대해 감옥살이를 하게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: Those who commit crimes will eventually go to prison for their actions.

meaningEn: to make merry; to amuse oneself

sentences.hanzi: 大家聚在一起唱歌作乐，气氛很热闹。
sentences.pinyin: da4 jia1 ju4 zai4 yi4 qi3 chang4 ge1 zuo4 le4, qi4 fen1 hen3 re4 nao5.
sentences.meaningKo: 모두가 함께 모여 노래하며 즐겨서 분위기가 매우 흥겨웠다.
sentences.meaningEn: Everyone gathered together to sing and make merry, and the atmosphere was very lively.

meaningEn: to act as a matchmaker

sentences.hanzi: 村里有位热心的大妈，常常帮年轻人做媒。
sentences.pinyin: cun1 li3 you3 wei4 re4 xin1 de5 da4 ma1, chang2 chang2 bang1 nian2 qing1 ren2 zuo4 mei2.
sentences.meaningKo: 마을에는 열성적인 아주머니 한 분이 계셔서 젊은 사람들에게 자주 중매를 서 주신다.
sentences.meaningEn: There is an enthusiastic auntie in the village who often acts as a matchmaker for young people.

meaningEn: never imagined even in one's dreams

sentences.hanzi: 他做梦也没想到，自己会在这里再次见到老朋友。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 meng4 ye3 mei2 xiang3 dao4, zi4 ji3 hui4 zai4 zhe4 li3 zai4 ci4 jian4 dao4 lao3 peng2 you3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그는 자신이 이곳에서 옛 친구를 다시 만나게 될 줄은 꿈에도 생각하지 못했다.
sentences.meaningEn: He never imagined even in his dreams that he would meet an old friend here again.

meaningEn: to be located in; to be situated at

sentences.hanzi: 这所学校坐落于城南的一片安静区域。
sentences.pinyin: zhe4 suo3 xue2 xiao4 zuo4 luo4 yu2 cheng2 nan2 de5 yi2 pian4 an1 jing4 qu1 yu4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이 학교는 성 남쪽의 한 조용한 지역에 위치해 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: This school is located in a quiet area in the south of the city.

meaningEn: manner; style of conduct; bearing

sentences.hanzi: 他的作派一向稳重，不喜欢张扬。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 pai4 yi2 xiang4 wen3 zhong4, bu4 xi3 huan1 zhang1 yang2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 처신 방식은 늘 신중하고 자신을 드러내는 것을 좋아하지 않는다.
sentences.meaningEn: His manner has always been steady, and he does not like to show off.

meaningEn: level of composition skill

sentences.hanzi: 经过多年的训练，他的作曲水平提高得很快。
sentences.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 nian2 de5 xun4 lian4, ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 shui3 ping2 ti2 gao1 de5 hen3 kuai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 수년간의 훈련을 거치면서 그의 작곡 수준은 매우 빠르게 향상되었다.
sentences.meaningEn: After many years of training, his level of composition improved very quickly.

meaningEn: to watch rivals fight from the sidelines and wait to benefit
meaningKo: 강 건너 불구경하다; 남의 싸움을 지켜보다 이익을 노리다

sentences.hanzi: 如果我们互相消耗，别人就可能坐山观虎斗，最后渔翁得利。
sentences.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 hu4 xiang1 xiao1 hao4, bie2 ren2 jiu4 ke3 neng2 zuo4 shan1 guan1 hu3 dou4, zui4 hou4 yu2 weng1 de2 li4.
sentences.meaningKo: 우리가 서로 소모전을 벌이면 다른 사람이 강 건너 불구경하며 결국 이익을 챙길 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: If we wear each other down, others may sit by and watch the fight, eventually reaping the benefits.

meaningEn: composition contest; essay competition

sentences.hanzi: 她在这次全国作文比赛中获得了一等奖。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 zai4 zhe4 ci4 quan2 guo2 zuo4 wen2 bi3 sai4 zhong1 huo4 de2 le5 yi1 deng3 jiang3.
sentences.meaningKo: 그녀는 이번 전국 작문 대회에서 1등상을 받았다.
sentences.meaningEn: She won first prize in this national composition contest.

meaningEn: manuscript organizer; person soliciting contributions

sentences.hanzi: 组稿人需要提前联系作者，确认交稿时间。
sentences.pinyin: zu3 gao3 ren2 xu1 yao4 ti2 qian2 lian2 xi4 zuo4 zhe3, que4 ren4 jiao1 gao3 shi2 jian1.
sentences.meaningKo: 원고 모집 담당자는 저자들과 미리 연락해 원고 제출 시간을 확인해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: The person soliciting contributions needs to contact the authors in advance and confirm the submission time.

meaningEn: to jack up the price on the spot; to demand a higher price opportunistically

sentences.hanzi: 谈好的价格不能临时坐地起价，这样会失去信任。
sentences.pinyin: tan2 hao3 de5 jia4 ge2 bu4 neng2 lin2 shi2 zuo4 di4 qi3 jia4, zhe4 yang4 hui4 shi1 qu4 xin4 ren4.
sentences.meaningKo: 이미 합의한 가격을 임시로 올려 버리면 신뢰를 잃게 된다.
sentences.meaningEn: A price that has already been agreed upon should not be raised on the spot, or trust will be lost.

meaningEn: schedule arrangement; work-rest arrangement

sentences.hanzi: 合理的作息安排能帮助我们保持更好的状态。
sentences.pinyin: he2 li3 de5 zuo4 xi1 an1 pai2 neng2 bang1 zhu4 wo3 men5 bao3 chi2 geng4 hao3 de5 zhuang4 tai4.
sentences.meaningKo: 합리적인 생활 시간 배치는 더 좋은 상태를 유지하는 데 도움을 준다.
sentences.meaningEn: A reasonable work-rest arrangement can help us maintain a better condition.

meaningEn: to think carefully from all sides; to ponder repeatedly

sentences.hanzi: 这件事关系重大，我左思右虑之后才答应下来。

sentences.meaningEn: Work cannot be just for show; the key lies in the actual results.

meaningEn: to build a team; to form a team

sentences.hanzi: 想把项目做好，首先要组建一支可靠的团队。
sentences.pinyin: xiang3 ba3 xiang4 mu4 zuo4 hao3, shou3 xian1 yao4 zu3 jian4 yi4 zhi1 ke3 kao4 de5 tuan2 dui4.

meaningEn: to make a decision

meaningEn: to direct from the scene; to command in person

sentences.pinyin: wei4 le5 que4 bao3 an1 quan2, fu4 ze2 ren2 zheng3 wan3 dou1 zai4 xian4 chang3 zuo4 zhen4 zhi3 hui1.

meaningEn: combat capability; operational capacity

meaningEn: symposium; discussion meeting; forum

sentences.hanzi: 学校今天下午召开了一场关于阅读的座谈会。
sentences.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 jin1 tian1 xia4 wu3 zhao4 kai1 le5 yi4 chang3 guan1 yu2 yue4 du2 de5 zuo4 tan2 hui4.

meaningEn: compositional style; style of composition

sentences.hanzi: 他的作曲风格独特，一听就能分辨出来。
sentences.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 qu3 feng1 ge2 du2 te4, yi4 ting1 jiu4 neng2 fen1 bian4 chu1 lai2.
sentences.meaningKo: 그의 작곡 스타일은 독특해서 한 번만 들어도 구별할 수 있다.
sentences.meaningEn: His compositional style is unique and can be recognized after just one listen.

meaningEn: scholar; person engaged in academic work

sentences.hanzi: 做学问的人尤其要讲求严谨和求真。

meaningEn: submission requirements; manuscript solicitation requirements

meaningEn: to sit and wait passively

sentences.hanzi: 面对变化，我们不能坐待机会流失。

sentences.meaningKo: 변화를 마주했을 때 우리는 가만히 앉아 기회가 흘러가도록 둘 수 없다.
sentences.meaningEn: When facing change, we cannot sit and wait while opportunities slip away.

meaningEn: graphing method; method of drawing diagrams

sentences.meaningEn: Using a graphing method to solve this problem will be a bit more intuitive.

meaningEn: seating order; seating arrangement

sentences.meaningKo: 그의 일 처리 방식은 늘 간결하고 효율적이다.
sentences.meaningEn: His style of doing things has always been concise and efficient.

meaningEn: to give a report; to make a presentation

meaningEn: to have a normal routine; regular work-rest pattern

sentences.meaningKo: 편집부는 다음 달 원고 모집 계획을 이미 초보적으로 확정했다.

sentences.meaningEn: The police found several key witnesses.

meaningEn: rough in manner; coarse and overbearing in style

sentences.meaningEn: A rough manner not only fails to solve problems, but also intensifies conflicts.

meaningEn: sitting posture

meaningEn: operational plan; combat scheme

sentences.pinyin: xin1 de5 zuo4 zhan4 fang1 an4 bi3 yuan2 lai2 de5 geng4 zhou1 mi4.
sentences.meaningKo: 새로운 작전 방안은 원래 것보다 더 치밀하다.
sentences.meaningEn: The new operational plan is more thorough than the original one.

sentences.meaningKo: 원고 모집 편집자는 저자와 긴밀한 연락을 유지해야 한다.
sentences.meaningEn: A commissioning editor needs to maintain close contact with authors.

meaningEn: to make a summary; to conclude
